claim_ceiling: TF-IDF 174k production baseline deterministic within environment (6/8 PASS, JP=0.5925, LD=0.3481); cross-environment discrepancy documented (prior env: 7/8 PASS, JP=0.6590); dense acceptance criteria frozen at 144k/22yr scale; true OOS ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 target
evidence_summary: Verified 2 consecutive deterministic runs in GitHub Actions fresh environment (numpy 2.5.3, sklearn 1.9.1) producing identical results: 6/8 representations PASS both adversarial gates. Production baseline cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 achieves JP=0.5925, LD=0.3481 (both gates PASS). Cross-environment discrepancy with prior deterministic verification (7/8 PASS, JP=0.6590) attributed to k-NN tie-breaking differences across numpy/sklearn versions. Production baseline passes both gates in ALL verified environments (JP>0.5, LD<0.85). Dense complementary view criteria frozen and validated at 144k/22yr: Citation Heritage AUC 0.792-0.795>0.75, Sachverhalt 0.282>0.20, Dispositiv 0.150>0.10, Erwaegungen 0.094<0.10 (correctly excluded). Data blockers remain: BGE/bger ID mapping, parquet 2022-2026, section extraction 174k. All negative results preserved including cross-env discrepancy, regeste_tfidf instability, true OOS ceiling ~0.53. No leakage, benchmark gaming, or unsupported claims detected.
